lines.x: File management? Alright, then. Teach me how. Okay... Sort them first. Like this? Then put them in order, by date… Uh. I tore the paper… S-Sorry. I didn't mean to.

Some of the people here. Don't you think they're a little too tall? No, I don't care. Not actually. How tall you are and how strong you are don't relate. I just need to bring every last one of them down.
What's my tribe gonna do now that I'm gone? That's a dumb question. See who has the bigger fists. The biggest is the new leader. Then they're done. That's it.

I heard a lot about Gavial. Like how she can crush a rock with her abs, and tear a raging beast apart with one hand. Is she actually that strong? Stronger than Chief Blaze? Warfarin said if I get treatment from Gavial, I'll know firsthand how strong she is. It's worth a try... Hm? Doctor, why are you stopping me?
I came here to get stronger, and that hasn't changed. Not just Chief Blaze and Gavial, there's a lot of people here worth challenging... What? I look happy? You're right. I sort of like being here.

The Rhodes Islanders. They all think too much. You too, Doctor. You have to think about so many things every day. You must be tired. You're not? You have to do it? Hmm, I guess that's true. There's a lot of stuff only you know how to handle. So it has to be you... Alright then, keep it up. Shout any time you need me.
Doctor, I need help. The flower basket up there. Get it down for me. What? You can't reach either? This sucks... Okay. I got an idea. How about I lift you up?

Zumama's going on the same mission as me this time? Don't worry. I won't pick a fight with her. We'll have lots of chances to settle our score. Also, if we started fighting, that would make things hard for you, right? Yeah. I don't want to do that to you.

This flower. Don't you think it's pretty? I grew this one myself. Hey, why are you so surprised? I'm not so crazy about fighting that I only care about getting stronger. Having a hobby or two is completely normal, okay? You... You like it too? Then I'll give you this one. Not bad. It suits you.
Doctor, I picked a flower and... You're asleep? Aren't you lazy? I'll just put this flower on your head. Mm, looks pretty good.

We meet again, huh. I'm the tallest, strongest warrior of my tribe, Flint. I hear you've got a lot of strong people around here? Great. I'll challenge them one by one. Oh, right. Do you know where I can find Chief Blaze?
Not bad. Very nice move. Doctor, I want to challenge this warrior! Where can I find him?
Promotion? Sure, do whatever you want, but I can keep fighting like I was already, right?

Doctor, you. You've been thinking too much. Any enemies, we can hit them away with our fists! Come. Relax a little. You need to loosen up when it's time to take a rest. Do you want to come over here and lie down with me?
Got it. Shout for me when it's time to go.
No problem. Leave it to me.
We're going. Each of you, watch your cover. Don't leave any tracks.
Here comes the prey!
Let's do this.
Got it.
One round, let's go.
Will you come one by one? Or all at once?
Heh. I've been waiting!
Taste my fist!
That look in your eyes, it disgusts me.
Don't look down on me!
You can find victory even without your fists? Heh. I guess that's your style...
Good job. Didn't know it, but you really are skilled.
Tch. Just some weaklings. Let them go. They're not worth chasing.
Don't blame yourself. It's my fault. I'm still not strong enough.
Hey. Can I hang a sandbag or two in my room?
Uwah!
Huh? What are you doing squatting down over here? You want me to pat your head?
Arknights.
So much food and so many presents... Say, how about ringing in the New Year with a nice boxing match? It would be hard on Medical? How come? They've got Gavial.
Let's pull it together. Anything you need me to help with today?

Here, a pair of boxing gloves and a bouquet of flowers. Which one do you want? Both fights and flowers can lift your mood, and I want you to be happier. It really feels like you're being too hard on yourself. Oh, know what? I'll give you both. Happy birthday.

I used to be determined to beat anyone who looked down on me. It wasn't until I came to Rhodes Island that I found there were a lot more ways to prove myself. Say, finishing a mission, helping others... Yeah, I learned a lot of new things here.
